english_example: They had to abandon the car when it broke down.
zh_tw_example_translation: 車子壞掉時，他們不得不把車丟在那裡。

english_example: She will be able to finish the project by Friday.
zh_tw_example_translation: 她到週五就能把專案做完。

english_example: The doctor noticed an abnormal heart rhythm during the check-up.
zh_tw_example_translation: 醫生在檢查時發現心律異常。

zh_tw_definition: 在船上；在飛機上；在車上
english_example: We went aboard the ferry at nine o'clock.
zh_tw_example_translation: 我們在九點時登上渡輪。

zh_tw_definition: 原住民（較舊的稱呼，現今通常建議使用 Indigenous people）
english_example: The aborigines of the region lived there long before the first European settlers arrived.
zh_tw_example_translation: 早在第一批歐洲移民抵達之前，當地原住民就已經在這片土地上生活。

english_example: Please refer to the above paragraph for more details.
zh_tw_example_translation: 請參閱上述段落以了解詳情。

english_example: His absence from the meeting was noticed by everyone.
zh_tw_example_translation: 大家都注意到他沒來開會。

zh_tw_definition: 缺席的、不在的、心不在焉的
english_example: She was absent from school for three days due to illness.
zh_tw_example_translation: 她因病缺課三天。

english_example: The party was an absolute disaster.
zh_tw_example_translation: 那場派對簡直是一場災難。

english_example: I absolutely agree with your proposal.
zh_tw_example_translation: 我完全同意你的提議。

english_example: Plants absorb water through their roots.
zh_tw_example_translation: 植物透過根部吸收水分。

zh_tw_definition: 抽象的、理論的、非具體的
english_example: The concept of justice is abstract and hard to define.
zh_tw_example_translation: 正義的概念很抽象，難以定義。

english_example: There was an abundance of fresh food at the market.
zh_tw_example_translation: 市場上有大量新鮮食材。

english_example: The region has abundant natural resources.
zh_tw_example_translation: 該地區擁有豐富的天然資源。

zh_tw_definition: 學術的、學校的、理論上的
english_example: She has a strong academic background in biology.
zh_tw_example_translation: 她在生物學方面有深厚的學術背景。

english_example: He enrolled in a military academy after graduation.
zh_tw_example_translation: 畢業後他進入了軍事學院就讀。

english_example: She speaks English with a slight Scottish accent.
zh_tw_example_translation: 她說英語帶著輕微的蘇格蘭口音。

english_example: Her acceptance into the university made her family very happy.
zh_tw_example_translation: 她獲得大學錄取，讓全家人都非常開心。

zh_tw_definition: 進入、使用權、接近的機會
english_example: Students have access to the library until 10 pm.
zh_tw_example_translation: 學生可以使用圖書館直到晚上十點。

zh_tw_definition: 可進入的、可獲得的、易懂的
english_example: The building is fully accessible for wheelchair users.
zh_tw_example_translation: 這棟大樓完全無障礙，輪椅使用者也能進出自如。
